notes.title: CardScrawl 1.0 Launch: Full Release is Here!
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]CardScrawl 1.0 is now live![/b][/u][/h3][p]The game has officially left Early Access. Version 1.0 includes final polish, quality-of-life improvements, and several bug fixes to ensure a smoother and more consistent experience.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who played and provided feedback during development. We hope you enjoy the full release. We'll continue supporting the game with future updates and bug fixes as needed.[b]

[u]The 1.0 Release Patch Notes are below:[/u]
[/b][/p][p][u][b]General Improvements[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Enchantment Descriptions[/b]: All enchantments now use "Equipped creature" wording for naming consistency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stone Skin & Haste[/b]: Fixed incorrect description text being displayed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AP Regen Status Bar Text[/b]: "Ap Recharge" has been renamed to [b]"Ap Regen"[/b] for consistency in the status bar.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Visual Clarity & Input Polish[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Creature Mouseover Highlight[/b]: Hovering over creatures now uses a distinct selector color for improved visual feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Equip Target Selector (Controller/Keyboard)[/b]: When equipping a creature, a selector now appears over the target for clearer targeting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse & Keyboard Improvements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]The mouse no longer shows the equipment icon over invalid tiles or already-equipped creatures.[/p][/*][*][p]This also resolves an issue where the mouse would override keyboard input in mixed control use, resulting in smoother, more intuitive hybrid input behavior.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][u][b]Tutorial Polish[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Creature Unsummon SFX[/b]: Added sound effects when creatures are unsummoned for better consistency in the tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Champion Unlock Fixes[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Unlock Bug Resolution[/b]: Champions affected by the earlier unlock bug (fixed in RC1.1) should now be unlocked correctly.
[i](Note: Anyone playing RC1.1 or newer is not affected.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlock UI Update[/b]: Champion unlock conditions now display full descriptions instead of just achievement names. Progress trackers have also been added for those unlocked via in-game criteria.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please check out the basic "How A Match Works" video below:

[/p][previewyoutube="DrlexvewgjU;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: RC 1 Update - Gameplay, Visual, and Bug Fixes
notes.content: [h2]RC 1 Update - Gameplay, Visual, and Bug Fixes[/h2][p]We are excited to release our first [b]Release Candidate[/b] for the game. This marks a major milestone as we focus on refining gameplay, improving clarity, and resolving remaining issues as we move toward a full release. Thank you for all your feedback and support as we continue to polish the game.[/p][h3][b]Champion Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Battle Knight Wonder:[/b] Fixed an issue where the opponent's ability would damage their own creatures (Player version was correct).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nocturne:[/b] Opponent's creatures without enchantments are now darkened, as they cannot be targeted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Valeena:[/b] Ability effect no longer plays on creatures without enchantments (visual fix only).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Koross:[/b] All tiles other than opponent's creatures are now darkened during ability targeting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Immolator:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where creatures summoned after casting the ability would not receive the correct power bonus.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability is now usable during the Summon Phase to prevent unintended gameplay interactions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Cat Kaiser:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ability would incorrectly skip the movement phase if a creature advance occurred. This has been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Visuals for the extra combat phase have been corrected to accurately reflect gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Enchantment and Board Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Arcane Aberration:[/b] Ability has been reworked to create Manaburn Sigils on the board that deal damage based on a creature's mana cost. These sigils cannot be overridden by Flame or Stone Sigils for their duration and pierce Enchantment Immunity. The pattern appears staggered across the board depending on whether the player or opponent casts it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flame Sigil:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage text now displays the actual damage amount instead of showing it as a percentage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Enchantment Immunity:[/b] All text and phase names updated for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Green Cast Arrow Sprite:[/b] Corrected visual issue with the casting arrow.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]General Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Summon and Action Phases have been reworked so that the opponent completes all of their actions first, followed by the player. This change allows players to better react to the opponent and streamlines gameplay. We also thinks this makes the game more enjoyable.[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional polish to ability mouseovers for champions such as Zod.[/p][/*][*][p]Flashing Border for Enchantments: Creatures with enchantments that are on a 1-turn cooldown now have a flashing border, indicating they will cast their enchantment this turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Phase name updated for consistency ("Casting Spell Immunity" is now "Casting Enchantment Immunity").[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Tutorial and UI Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Help menu can no longer be opened during tutorials via the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Advanced View Mode Tutorial: Now forces Advanced View to be active for consistency. A disclaimer is shown at the start.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Round Order Tutorial: Updated with examples that reflect recent visual changes such as the flashing border behavior.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some opponents (such as Zod and Valeena) would incorrectly use their abilities when they would have no effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected selector placement in the Advanced Board View Tutorial to prevent overlapping important information.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where using player abilities during the Summon Phase with a full board could cause the ability to fail and the turn to pass to the opponent.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for playing and for all the feedback as we head toward a full release. The development team is continuing to work on additional polish and visual improvements in the coming weeks.[/p]

tags.bug: [b]Battle Knight Wonder:[/b] Fixed an issue where the opponent's ability would damage their own creatures (Player version was correct).
Ability effect no longer plays on creatures without enchantments (visual fix only).
Fixed an issue where creatures summoned after casting the ability would not receive the correct power bonus.
Ability would incorrectly skip the movement phase if a creature advance occurred. This has been corrected.
Visuals for the extra combat phase have been corrected to accurately reflect gameplay.
Damage text now displays the actual damage amount instead of showing it as a percentage.
Corrected visual issue with the casting arrow.
Fixed an issue where some opponents (such as Zod and Valeena) would incorrectly use their abilities when they would have no effect.
Corrected selector placement in the Advanced Board View Tutorial to prevent overlapping important information.
Resolved a bug where using player abilities during the Summon Phase with a full board could cause the ability to fail and the turn to pass to the opponent.

notes.title: CardScrawl EA 9 Update Is Live!
notes.content:
[u][b]Visual Clarity & UI Improvements[/b][/u]

[b]Enhanced Readability[/b]
•	Tutorial Improvements: Status Effects, How To Read Cards, and Target Types tutorials now highlight relevant elements for much clearer learning
•	Selector Borders: Added visual borders throughout the game when summoning, equipping, and targeting for better board readability
•	Combat Clarity: Creatures attacking each other now display selector borders, and arrows appear above creatures casting enchantments
•	Target Information: Enhanced target pattern displays during combat and when hovering over creatures

[b]Menu & Interface[/b]
•	Settings Menu: Fixed issue where Settings and Help menus could incorrectly open simultaneously
•	Save Data Display: Improved readability of save prompts and fixed incorrect difficulty/floor information display
•	Tutorial Progress: Added progress indicator on the Status Bar during tutorials
•	Advanced Tooltips: More champion abilities now show detailed target information when hovering

[u][b]Gameplay & Balance Changes[/b][/u]

[b]Core Mechanics[/b]
•	Starting Enchantment Deck: Normalized to be consistent across all runs for better early game balance
•	Round Rewards: Reordered end-of-round rewards - Spoils now come first, followed by card selection
•	Spell Immunity: Renamed to "Enchantment Immunity" for consistency

[b]Champion Abilities[/b]
•	Audio: Fixed missing sound effects for Cat Kaiser, Nocturne, and Rock and Roll Troll abilities
•	Visual Effects: Restored missing visual effects for Dracarath's champion ability
•	Targeting: Improved ability targeting for Brute when using a controller/keyboard
•	Animation Speed: Updated ability animation timing for Wonder, Brute, Zod, Koross, and Nocturne

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[b]Audio & Visual[/b]
•	Ghost Cards: Fixed sounds playing when player was out of cards
•	Music System: Resolved issue where pausing/resuming caused looping instead of track progression
•	Creature Cards: Corrected power and mana color display on inactive creature cards
•	Spoils Display: Fixed rare spoils showing incorrect information on mouseover

[b]Gameplay[/b]
•	Chaos Hardcore: Removed incorrect save file prompts and updated mode description to clarify no saving is allowed
•	Oni: Now correctly inherits Tower Lord's first ability for the match (wasn't getting an ability before).
•	Tutorial Descriptions: Updated to clarify they're best viewed after playing at least one match

[b]Interface[/b]
•	Ability Buttons: Active ability border now disappears on mouseover to match opponent behavior
•	Enchantment Targeting: Improved clarity when using targeting abilities by hiding conflicting target information whenever using Character Abilities that select a target(s) (Brute, Koross, etc.).

Thank you for your continued support during Early Access! Happy dungeon crawling!

The CardScrawl Team

notes.title: CardScrawl EA 8 Update Is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Scrawlers,

Today’s EA 8 update brings one of our biggest batches of changes yet. We’ve overhauled the tutorial system, added a challenging new game mode, cleaned up visuals, fixed several ability issues, and made important balance adjustments. This patch should make everything from onboarding to high-level play feel smoother and more rewarding.

[u][b]New Game Mode: Amplify Trial[/b][/u]
The experimental Tower of Eternity has been shelved—it didn’t meet our standards for long-term fun. In its place, we’ve added Amplify Trial, a fresh mode that gives you rare spoils after every fight to let your builds ramp faster. But beware: enemy scaling is even more brutal than Chaos Gauntlet.

[u][b]Tutorial Rework + Quick Rules[/b][/u]
The old tutorial was bloated and overwhelming. We’ve now split it into smaller, easier-to-digest sections that focus on only the most important mechanics. This should help both new and returning players get up to speed without wading through too much text.

[u][b]Gameplay & Balance Improvements[/b][/u]

Combat Round Order Tweaked: APDegeneration now resolves after APRegeneration, allowing more consistent ability use.

Several champion abilities (like Grovekeeper, Salvatore De Mort, Drel, and Bulwark) now provide real-time number previews or improved targeting clarity.

Random “target” types on starting deck enchantments have been weakened for balance.

Damage enchantment in starting decks has been tuned.

Level 1 AP Regen/Degen cooldowns standardized to 1 turn (no more 3-turn waits).

Cat Kaiser, Wonder, Bulwark, and others now highlight valid targets when casting abilities.

[u][b]Visual, UI & Audio Tweaks[/b][/u]

Updated animations for card draw, ability activation, and summon selection

Ability bar now flashes when ready

New sound effects for card movements, Flame Sigil, and more

Better readability for combat tooltips and numbers on abilities

Mouseovers added for lane power and deck indicators

Health bar, ability icons, and FX tweaks to Wretched Cretin, Weeping Maiden, and others

[u][b]Misc Fixes & Updates[/b][/u]

Narrator voice lines refreshed

Vampiric Strike effect position fixed

Help button removed from tutorial

The current floor text now displays the maximum amount of floors on the game board

The current game mode now displays on the game board

All Champion lore and endgame text updated

Thank you, as always, for your continued support and bug reports. EA 8 makes CardScrawl cleaner, clearer, and more challenging—and we’re already working on what’s next.

See you in the Amplify Trial... if you dare.

— The Mire Studios Team

notes.title: CardScrawl EA 7 Update Is Live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Scrawlers,[/b]

Our latest update, EA 7, is here—and it’s focused on making your time in the Chaos Tower smoother, clearer, and a bit more fair.

[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b]

[u][b]Quick Rules Page Added[/b][/u]
We’ve introduced a Quick Rules page for players who want a fast and accessible way to learn the core mechanics without committing to the full tutorial. You can access it anytime via the new HELP button on the game board. First-time players will now see the Quick Rules instead of being prompted for the full tutorial.

[u][b]Ability Feedback Improvements[/b][/u]

The ability bar now flashes when a champion ability is ready to use during the summon or action phase depending on when your Champion Ability is useable.

The current game mode is now displayed during runs under the floors/turns display.

Kozikth's ability now shows an icon over the first selected target for better clarity.

Cat Kaiser now targets a single allied Creature of your choice rather than all.

Cat Kaiser Stat Adjustment: +10 starting HP and 10 less maximum AP.

[u][b]UI/UX Enhancements[/b][/u]

Glyphs (controller prompts) are now properly displayed in the settings menu when cycling through windows with keyboard/controller.

The Settings Menu "Board View Type" description has been updated to clarify that bumpers toggle between info panels in Simple mode.

The Player's and Opponent's Creature and Enchantment Hands now fade out when they’re not usable—still hoverable, just clearer. This should greatly reduce bloat and make the UI much more clear for new players.

As always, thank you for your support and feedback! Every bit of it helps us improve the game and make CardScrawl the best it can be.

See you in the arena—and don’t forget to try the new Quick Rules if you're showing the game to a friend!

— The Mire Studios Team

notes.title: EA 5 Update – Achievement Fixes, New Enchantments, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Hey duelists,[/b]

We’ve just launched the [b]EA 5 Update[/b] for CardScrawl! This update is packed with meaningful improvements to achievements, gameplay balance, and the save system. Let’s get into it:

🏆 [u]Achievement & Unlock Fixes[/u]
The [b]Enchanting Mastery[/b] achievement was missing and has now been added. [b]Valeena[/b] is now unlockable!

The following achievements [b]now properly unlock their Champions[/b]:
[i]Mana Burnout, Feywild Pact, Mana Master, Direct Assault, Flawless Victory, Forged in Stone, Demoncaller, Graveborn Army, Full Summon[/i]

[b]Save system updated[/b]: Characters now unlock immediately and consistently.

🧩 [u]Achievement Difficulty Rebalancing[/u]
To give players clearer progression, we’ve reorganized which difficulties certain achievements require:

[b]Now unlockable on any difficulty:[/b]
[i]Novice Duelist, Mana Master, Direct Assault, Full Summon, Creature Collector, Forged in Stone, Demoncaller, Graveborn Army, Feywild Pact, Mana Burnout, Enchanting Mastery, Champion's Journey[/i]

[b]Now require Classic Ascent or higher:[/b]
[i]Trial By Fire, Swift Victory, Underdog Victory, Overkill, Chain Reaction, Champion’s Edge, Legendary Summoner, Overwhelming Force, Legendary Slayer, Card Shark, Flawless Victory, Resourceful, Defender of the Tower, Decked Out, Out of Options[/i]

[b]Require Chaos Gauntlet or higher:[/b]
[i]Rising Challenger, Tower Explorer, Master of The Tower[/i]

[b]Require Chaos Hardcore:[/b]
[i]Unyielding Will[/i]

[b]Creature Collector[/b] requirement increased: 15 → 30 creatures.

[b]Overwhelming Force[/b]: Now requires 9 creatures on the board at once (up from 6).

🧪 [u]Gameplay Changes & Balancing[/u]
[b]Charm nerfed:[/b] Charmed creatures no longer deal direct damage when reaching the board's end—they return to their original summoner instead.

[b]Heal Enchantment removed:[/b] It was underperforming and has been retired.

[b]Double Strike removed:[/b] Too similar to First Strike, so we've cut it to reduce bloat.

[b]New Enchantments Added:[/b]

[b]Vampiric Strike:[/b] Creatures with this permanent enchantment heal for its value when they deal melee damage.

[b]APDegeneration:[/b] A counter to APRegeneration—it drains enemy Ability Power each round.

✨ [u]Visuals, Effects, and Feedback[/u]
[b]New FX for Dracarath and Ratburg[/b] when using their Champion Abilities.

[b]New Game Board font[/b] – Easier to read and much cleaner!

[b]Combat Round Order changed:[/b]

[b]Stone Sigil[/b] casts first now—before Silence.

[b]APDegeneration[/b] now casts right after APRegeneration.

[b]Announcer setting now has an audio cue[/b] when toggled in settings.

⚠️ [u]Important Save Note[/u]
Due to these updates, [b]old save files are incompatible[/b] and will be deleted when you launch the new version. However, your [b]achievements and unlocks will carry over just fine.[/b] You’ll be right back in the climb.

As always, thank you for playing and sharing your feedback—it truly helps shape CardScrawl’s development. This update lays the groundwork for even more content and polish coming soon!

See you in the arena,
[b]—The Mire Studios Team[/b]

notes.title: EA 3 Update – Status Effects Overhaul & Expanded Settings!
notes.content:
[b]Duelists, a new update has arrived![/b]

EA 3 brings a wave of improvements to CardScrawl, making battles easier to read, settings more customizable, and mechanics clearer than ever. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[b]🛠 Status Effect Overhaul – Better Clarity at a Glance![/b]
No more guessing what effects are active—status effects now change the color of a creature’s board tile, giving you instant visual feedback:

Silence – Teal
Double Strike – Red
First Strike – Orange
Root – Green
Spell Immunity – Yellow
Charm – Pink
Additionally, status effect icons in the order panel now feature their corresponding colors on the sides for quick reference!

[b]⚙️ Expanded Settings Menu – More Control Over Your Game![/b]
We’ve expanded the settings menu and organized options into dedicated tabs. New adjustable settings include:
✅ Screen Camera Shake – Toggle screen shake when taking or receiving direct damage
✅ Screen Color Flash – Toggle screen flash effects when taking or receiving direct damage (Now disabled by default)
✅ SFX Volume – Adjust sound effects and narrator volume
✅ Music Volume – Adjust game music volume
✅ Window Render Resolution – Change game window render resolution

Bonus: Your settings for Screen Camera Shake and Screen Color Flash are now saved between sessions!

🎭 Scum’s Ability – New Visual Feedback!
Scum’s ability now provides clear visual feedback—any creature affected will transform into a Festering Abomination. This doesn’t change how the ability functions, but it ensures you always know when Scum has done his work. The ability’s description has also been updated for clarity.

📜 Additional Fixes & Changes:
- Updated Stone Skin and Berserk descriptions to better reflect their effects.
- Shortened Fortune enchantment description for better readability.
- Mouse can now be used to clear the "Press Any Button" prompt on the main menu.
- Game Credits updated.
This update focuses on quality-of-life improvements, making CardScrawl more intuitive and user-friendly while keeping the core strategy intact. Let us know what you think in the discussions!
